headline: Kutztown remain the only side to beat West Chester
dek: West Chester have lost three times this season, and all three defeats have come against Kutztown, the latest last night. Against everyone else they have fourteen wins and three draws.
displaced_by: results night: Kutztown beat West Chester a third time and are still the only side to have beaten them
